attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn. It gives him no year at all, so this folder carries no dates; what it gives instead is the admission that he is missing from the printed books.
